title: DevOps Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a Cloud DevOps Engineer with hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, automation, CI/CD and observability. You will independently manage and improve cloud infrastructure across development and operational environments, with particular focus on Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI Services, AWS, AKS/EKS, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring.

The role combines cloud engineering and DevOps with operational responsibilities including incident, problem, change, release and deployment management. You will work closely with development teams to automate delivery, troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, improve reliability and support secure, scalable cloud environments.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Maintain and continuously improve cloud and DevOps infrastructure, including continuous integration infrastructure, build platforms, test systems and development environments.
* Manage cloud infrastructure end to end, including monitoring, reporting, networking, DNS and security.
* Build and manage Kubernetes clusters, including Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), with the ability to set up clusters from scratch.
* Set up and script cloud environments using infrastructure-as-code and automation practices.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
* Establish continuous delivery tooling and procedures covering build servers, automated deployment and configuration management.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible and relevant cloud-native technologies such as AWS CloudFormation.
* Support software rollouts across development, test and production environments.
* Partner with development teams on infrastructure, scalability, security and automation requirements.
* Configure and support Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, including networking, firewall, API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services.
* Configure and support APIs through the Apigee platform.
* Monitor applications and infrastructure using tools such as Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana and Datadog.
* Perform log analysis, including Fluentd-based logging, to identify and resolve application and infrastructure issues.
* Apply ITIL practices across incident resolution, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and deployment.
* Perform root-cause analysis, identify known errors and coordinate corrective actions.
* Support release and deployment activities within Unix/Linux-based environments.
* Apply Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies across software repositories.
* Support build and continuous integration activities using Maven and Gradle.
* Contribute effectively within DevOps and Agile/Scrum delivery teams.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have excellent knowledge of cloud platforms and services, particularly Microsoft Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* You have hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure and setting up monitoring and reporting.
* You have strong expertise in DevOps, automation and CI/CD/CT practices.
* You have hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes and cluster creation and deployment using AKS and EKS.
* You understand cloud networking, DNS, security and encryption.
* You have experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python or Ruby.
* You have experience with Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins.
* You understand Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies.
* You have experience with build tools such as Maven and Gradle.
* You have strong knowledge of observability and log analysis, with exposure to Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana, Datadog and Fluentd.
* You understand NoSQL technologies such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB and Cassandra.
* You have practical knowledge of ITIL processes, particularly Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, release and deployment.
* You have experience using ticketing and work management tools such as Remedy and Jira.
* You have experience with configuration management and software deployment across multiple environments.
* You understand Spring application development and the Spring Boot framework.
* You have practical experience with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, networking, firewalls, Azure API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services.
* You have a good understanding of the Apigee platform and API configuration.
* You bring analytical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, alongside a collaborative approach to problem solving.
* You communicate clearly, work effectively within a team and navigate disagreements constructively.
* Knowledge of Java is beneficial.
* Microsoft Azure and/or AWS certifications are beneficial.
* Experience working across international, multi-location teams is beneficial.
* You are comfortable learning new technologies, working independently and focusing on measurable outcomes.
* You understand software development and service management processes, including SDLC and ITIL, and can contribute to process improvement and innovation.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Exposure to cloud engineering across Microsoft Azure and AWS environments.
* Opportunities to work with Azure OpenAI Services and related generative AI technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes environments using AKS and EKS.
* Opportunities to contribute across cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, observability, API management and secure deployments.
* Collaboration with development, operations and delivery teams in an Agile environment.
* Experience solving scalability, security and infrastructure automation challenges.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Deeper practical expertise in cloud infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code.
* Advanced AKS/EKS and Kubernetes cluster deployment and operational practices.
* Enterprise implementation of Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services and generative AI supporting services.
* Cloud networking, DNS, security, firewall and API management practices.
* Advanced CI/CD and deployment automation using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible.
* Application and infrastructure observability using Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana, Datadog and Fluentd.
* API configuration and management practices using Azure API Management and Apigee.
* Cross-functional delivery practices spanning DevOps, Agile and ITIL environments.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Linux/AWS/GCP
description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. *We build it.*

**Position Summary**  
Kaseya is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our SaaS Backup engineering team and help build and operate the next generation of our backup storage platform. Kaseya's SaaS Backup products protect Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce data for hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. This role will focus on ensuring the reliability, scalability, and operational health of a unified, cloud-agnostic platform designed to operate across trillions of objects and petabytes of data.

The Senior DevOps Engineer will own Kubernetes infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and production reliability. Working closely with software engineering and platform teams, this individual will drive observability, lead incident response, strengthen infrastructure security, and take end-to-end ownership of the systems they build and operate.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own Kubernetes cluster operations, including provisioning, multi-tenant isolation, resource governance, and custom controllers.
* Design and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
* Build and maintain production-scale Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, following modular, versioned, and reusable design principles.
* Manage observability platforms using Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog; define SLOs/SLAs and reduce alert noise.
* Lead incident response, including on-call support, triage, runbooks, root cause analysis, and postmortems.
* Enforce infrastructure and pipeline security through Vault, RBAC, image scanning, and audit logging.
* Automate operational tasks using Go, Python, and Shell scripting while improving tooling across Ansible, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
* Manage hybrid networking, including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPCs, and overlay networks.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including at least 3 years managing large-scale production infrastructure.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes cluster operations, custom controllers, and multi-tenant workload isolation.
* Production-scale Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform, along with CI/CD pipeline ownership using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
* Experience with observability, SLO/SLA definition, incident management, structured on-call practices, and postmortems.
* Strong knowledge of Linux performance tuning, kernel parameters, storage I/O, hybrid networking, infrastructure security, and automation using Go or Python.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with OpenStack components, including Nova, Swift, Neutron, and Cinder, at scale.
* Experience managing multi-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, Azure, and private cloud.
* Experience operating large-scale infrastructure with 5,000+ nodes, including capacity planning and hardware lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of FinOps, cloud cost analysis, resource rightsizing, and storage tiering.
* Experience with Chaos Engineering tools such as Chaos Monkey, Litmus, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning technologies such as PXE, IPMI, Ironic, or MaaS.
* Experience with backup and disaster recovery concepts, including RPO/RTO, storage replication, and data protection pipelines.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA.

**Additional information**  
*Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Onit**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own delivery on AWS, and on Google Cloud and Azure where products run there: Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, container images, and the Jenkins and GitLab pipelines that promote a service from sandbox to production.
* Shape clusters for production workloads, including compute, autoscaling, worker processes, load balancing, and shared data services such as relational databases, cache, and object and file storage.
* Automate virtual machine and host configuration with Ansible, including build agents, bastion hosts, and supporting services that sit beside Kubernetes.
* Keep configuration and secrets safe across environments and cloud accounts. Secrets stay encrypted and access stays limited to the environments that need them.
* Lead releases and production incidents. Diagnose failed deploys, capacity problems, and dependency failures with the service owner, and close them with a change in infrastructure, charts, playbooks, or the pipeline.
* Bring new services, including AI platform components, onto the same release, security, and observability bar as the core products, on whichever cloud they run.
* Own observability and cost: metrics, logs, and traces that show whether a release is healthy, and a clear view of spend by environment and cloud.
* Hold the security baseline on the platform: identity and access, policy and runtime controls, image and dependency hygiene, and patch cadence for clusters, nodes, and hosts.
* Advance disaster recovery and environment consistency so failover and drift are operating practice, not a side project.
* Set patterns other engineers can follow, and review risky changes to shared infrastructure before they land.

### **Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps, site reliability, or cloud platform engineering, with several of those years leading production infrastructure.
* You have led Kubernetes platforms on AWS across more than one account, including production changes you owned through the incident. You have also operated workloads on Google Cloud, Azure, or both.
* You have standardized Terraform, Helm, and Ansible that other people can apply, including environment layout and secrets handling.
* You have run a real deploy path for many services and understand how image build, configuration, secrets, and load-balancer registration fit together.
* You can diagnose an unhealthy release: scheduling, health checks, worker backlog, and a deploy that does not become ready.
* You treat IAM, network boundaries, and secrets as part of the design, and you have operated cloud key management or an equivalent.
* You have run databases, cache, and shared storage under Kubernetes, including backup and a tested restore.
* You lead by setting the pattern and reviewing the risky changes, and you can pair with an engineer shipping infrastructure for the first time.

### **Skills**

* Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, VPC, ALB/NLB, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, S3, EFS, SQS/SNS, IAM/IRSA, KMS, CloudWatch). Working knowledge of Google Cloud and Azure for the products that run there.
* Kubernetes: EKS, Helm, workloads, autoscaling, pod disruption budgets, resource sizing, and production troubleshooting.
* Delivery: Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and Git. Helm releases and Ansible playbooks across many environments.
* Secrets: SOPS or equivalent, with cloud key management. No plaintext credentials in configuration.
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis or Valkey, and object and shared file storage in production, including backup and restore.
* Observability: metrics, logs, and traces (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Fluent Bit, CloudWatch, or equivalent) and cloud cost visibility.
* Security: IAM, network controls, policy-as-code, image and dependency scanning, and node and host patching.
* Networking: load balancers, ingress, and API gateway patterns in front of Kubernetes services.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.

Family Support: ***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

Income Protection: ***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident***.***

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: ***Flexi, NPS***.

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Onit Values**

**Customer First -** Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

**Purposeful Innovation -** Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

 AI Observability (ML Ops Engineer)

The AI Observability Engineer will be instrumental in implementation of scalable, cloud\-native solutions to meet the growing needs of our Data \& Development team. The AI Observability Engineer will build and maintain a robust framework to ensure the reliability and maintainability of DPR Construction's complex AI systems.

* Lead hands\-on implementation of automation\-first DevOps and MLOps practices, enabling infrastructure\-as\-code and consistent, repeatable environment provisioning
* Design and manage intelligent DataOps pipelines with automated data quality monitoring and anomaly detection
* Deploy, maintain and monitor containerized ML workloads
* Extend existing CI/CD pipelines to support automated infrastructure changes and ML workflows

* Establish governance frameworks for AI systems, including bias detection, explainability, and auditability
* Extend existing Azure RBAC strategy by automating role and permission management to reduce manual intervention
* Develop automated test suites for model performance, regression, edge cases and bias validation

* 8\-10 years of experience in DevOps, MLOps, Data Engineering, Software Engineering or Site Reliability Engineering

* Proficiency in at least one objected\-oriented programming language, preferably python with hands\-on experience in ml frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit\-learn
